acceptance: The governance doc names who responds to a gap issue and by when
An overdue gap issue produces a visible signal without manual checking
The release path either blocks on or reports open gap issues, as the owner decides
context: Found while answering which processes ensure soundness gap issues get addressed, then reviewing the seven open ones on 2026-11-12.
description:
## Problem
The soundness merge digest (_project/scripts/soundness_merge_digest.py, daily) opens a soundness-review-gap issue for each merged soundness-path commit without an accountable review, and closes it only on an attester's clean external review or a fix. Nothing assigns the issue, sets a deadline, or escalates it, and the label blocks nothing: scripts/release_blocker_check.py reads only release-blocking. On 2026-11-12, seven gap issues were open, the oldest from 2026-10-09, all with zero comments. Reviewing them found one live Medium defect (#2807) that had been carried into the current review gate in the meantime.

## Change
Decide and implement a response policy for gap issues, in proportion to the risk. Options to weigh: an owner and a response window stated in docs/internal/merge-queue-governance.md; a reminder or escalation when a gap issue passes that window; listing open gap issues in the release readiness check, as a warning or a block; running the external review automatically when the digest opens the issue.

## Guardrails
- Keep closure rules unchanged: only an attester's clean review or the missing-signal re-evaluation closes an issue.
- Owner decision on whether open gap issues may block a release.
